Real-world schema drift: codex emits `summary` instead of `title`, files as
`"path:line"` strings, severity in nonstandard form, and adds top-level metadata
fields that are not in the official SKILL.md schema. Parser must accept this
and emit warnings on stderr.

```yaml
LEDGER_PATCH:
  review_type: standard_adversarial
  branch: feat/example
  base: master
  verdict: findings
  findings:
    - id: R1-F1
      severity: critical
      status: open
      summary: "drift: summary field instead of title"
      files:
        - "src/example.py:42"
    - id: R1-F2
      severity: warning
      status: open
      summary: "drift: severity alias"
      files:
        - "tests/test_example.py:10-20"
```
